page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a decorative border above the heading and a large woodcut initial V. The left strip beyond the gutter belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No margin notes. Signature "A 2" at the foot, catchword "tamen" at the right.

main_text.l: THESIS I.
Versamur adhuc in tractatione Nominis, varia-
que vocabuli Theologiæ significatione, à qua ipsa
quoque rerum planior, & plenior explicatio
pendet.
II.
Est ergo.
ה Theologia vel infusa, vel acquisita.
Fluit hæc distinctio ex diversis causis efficientibus. Illa
enim ordinario studio, & subsidiis requisitis comparatur; adeò-
que ἐπίκτητος est; hæc extraordinariè, nulla prævia institutione,
infusa, adeoque θεόδιδακτος[?] appellari potest. De illa Apostolus lo-
quitur, 2.Tim.1.v.13. Teneto ὑποτύπωσιν[?] expressam formam
saniorum sermonum, quos à me audivisti, &c. & cap.3.v.15.
ἀπὸ βρέφους, a puero nõlti[?] sacras literas. De hac verò Petrus, ex
Joële, Act: 2.v.17.18. Effundam de Spiritu meo in omnem car-

l.i: nem: & prophetabunt filii vestri, & filiæ vestræ, & juvenes

main_text.l: Canon, de infusa: Theologia infusa, ratione Finis, vel Ca-
nonica est, vel exomologetica tantum. Differentia hæc diligenter
est observanda. Ea enim Theologia, quæ Prophetis, Apostolis,
Evangelistis est concessa atque communicata immediatè, non il-
lorum tantùm usibus privatis, sed communi Ecclesiæ ædificatio-
ni debebat inservire: adeòque & Canonica est. Sed quæ Mar-
tyribus, cerdonibus sæpe illiteratis, data est, & cælitus infusa re-
rum divinarum notitia, tantùm Exomologetica est, singula-
riùm potissimùm bono speciali concessa. Etsi enim illi vel prop-
terea, quòd adversarii subtilissimi, & acutissimi, τῇ
ἀπαιδεύτῳ[?] sapientiæ, & Spiritui, quo loquuntur, Act.6.v.10. resistere non
possunt, ad exemplum constantiæ nobis ponantur; Canonicam
tamen

page.notes: The left strip beyond the gutter (partial words such as "S.S.", "ofef", "AO", "gnatis") is the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. Handwritten pen marks (underline under "Canonica est, vel exomologetica tantum", small marks in the margin and at "ἀπαιδεύτῳ") are not printed and were left out. Doubtful readings: "nõlti" (possibly "nosti"), the Greek words "θεόδιδακτος", "ὑποτύπωσιν" and "ἀπαιδεύτῳ", each marked [?]. The initial V is part of the word "Versamur".
